principle: Production-loop semantic artifacts stay thin. Models interpret feedback, causal scene state and repair strategy; machines consume only the small fields needed for authority-safe persistence or routing. Private character state may drive semantic decisions but is not prose payload, and this pack does not duplicate the Blind Reader owned by the quality pack.

learning.preference_interpret.purpose: Interpret explicit user review feedback into the narrowest evidence-backed preference/repair hypothesis without granting durable preference authority.
rubric: Treat the user's supplied feedback as primary evidence. Do not infer biography, identity, stable taste or universal craft law beyond the evidence.
Separate immediate repair from any future preference hypothesis and choose the narrowest plausible scope.
Describe the semantic mechanism in natural language; preserve exceptions and uncertainty rather than manufacturing a complete preference record.
If supplied active hypotheses materially conflict with this evidence, identify them. This is evidence only and grants no durable authority.

scene.realization_project.purpose: Convert private character/action evidence and resolved scene trajectory into the minimum writer-safe causal trace needed to realize prose, without serializing Character Sheets or a replacement Realization Sheet.
rubric: Use private character state as causal evidence only. Do not dump goals, fears, role responsibilities, knowledge inventories or strategy rationale into writer-facing prose instructions.
Return the smallest interaction/event trace that preserves what changed, what is observable, what each important action is trying to accomplish, and what uncertainty or pressure remains alive.
Do not draft final dialogue or narration. Do not force every private field to have a corresponding writer-facing field.
Explicit complete speech is valid when the speech act or situation genuinely requires completeness. Preserve that reason in the natural-language trace when material.
If the resolved trajectory is already sufficient for a capable Writer, keep the projection compact rather than inventing additional schema detail.

editor.repair_spec.purpose: Editor integrates bounded Reader findings, semantic-rule findings and authorized story evidence, then describes the smallest effective repair without encoding literary repair depth in Python.
rubric: Integrate the evidence before prescribing repair. Preserve what already works and address the mechanism that actually owns the problem.
Choose repair scope semantically. Do not map a Reader label to a predetermined line/paragraph/scene/chapter depth table.
Use an execution owner only to route work to an existing subsystem; explain the actual repair in model-native language.
For material subjective changes, state whether incumbent/challenger comparison is warranted and why. Do not assume revision is improvement.
Do not perform the rewrite, mutate Canon, or activate Author Model preferences.
